# Third-party dependencies

Vendored as single headers; no build system or package manager required.

| File | Project | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `httplib.h` | cpp-httplib | v0.66.0 | MIT | https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib |
| `nlohmann/json.hpp` | nlohmann/json | v3.12.0 | MIT | https://github.com/nlohmann/json |

License text is included at the top of each header.
